name: gui_graph_task_delete
description: GL-5f, decision 2, with the Graph tab only (the Frame Plan's is never brought forward): a compute task a feature of the project declares is deleted on the Graph. Inside the feature's folded node the task is a node of its own; its detail column's Delete task is the Frame Plan's Delete (remove_compute_task), run after the Frame Plan read the plan, the context and the task catalog again although it is out of view. The plan has one node fewer and the feature's document no longer holds the task. An engine feature's task offers no Delete (unit test). Nothing is typed.
